aurelm_emby.title: Emby
aurelm_emby.description: The head unit as a cast target for the Emby phone app: sign in once from the phone (QR code), then choose "BMW iDrive" in Emby's cast menu. The film plays on the centre screen while parked, its sound on the car's speakers; pause, seek and stop from the phone. Needs the Emby cast service.
aurelm_emby.author: custom

aurelm_mediaprobe.title: Media Probe
aurelm_mediaprobe.description: What the car offers a music player (the first step of a Music Assistant client): the steering wheel's buttons, the source the HMI takes as playing, CarLife's bridge to BMW's media, button forwarding, and the BMW MediaPlayer's source for apps with files, a growing file, a pipe and http:// streams. Each test shows what the car answered; Report copies the log to a USB stick. Needs the Media Probe service.
aurelm_mediaprobe.author: custom
